basics.name: Mohamed Ahmed Rashed Atia
basics.label: Data Analyst
basics.summary: Data Analyst with an accounting degree from Alexandria University and hands-on training in Python, SQL Server, Power BI, and Tableau through the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI), Round 5. Built three end-to-end data analysis projects: a Python retail analytics pipeline, a SQL Server data warehouse with ETL, and linked Tableau dashboards. Combines accounting and financial reporting fundamentals with data cleaning, data visualization, and KPI reporting skills. English: C1.

work.name: Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI), Round 5, Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT)
work.summary: National scholarship and professional training track in data analytics.
highlights: Selected for a national scholarship and professional training track in data analytics.
Apply Python (Pandas) for data cleaning, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and object-oriented programming.
Write SQL using joins, common table expressions (CTEs), stored procedures, views, and database design.
Build interactive dashboards in Tableau and Power BI using Power Query, data modeling, and DAX.
Deliver six graded mini-projects across Python, SQL, Tableau, and Power BI, followed by an end-to-end capstone project with an executive presentation.

work.name: Commercial International Bank (CIB)
highlights: Completed a five-module banking internship: banking operations, ESG, financial literacy, entrepreneurship, and digital transformation.
Practiced professional communication and active listening in data-driven business contexts.

projects.name: Superstore Sales & Customer Dashboards
projects.description: DEPI Mini Project 3, team of 6. Tableau, SQL Server. 2026.
highlights: Built two linked Tableau dashboards on a SQL Server gold layer: sales, profit, and quantity KPIs with Jan-Dec trends and year-over-year % difference, plus customer counts, sales per customer, and top 10 customers by profit.
Designed KPIs that update dynamically with Category and Sub-Category filters, using a consistent color scheme (teal favorable, orange unfavorable).
Corrected inflated order counts caused by a missing Order ID by sourcing it from the silver layer and counting distinct orders; results reconcile to 325 customers in the 2016 view.

projects.name: SQL Data Warehouse & Business Analytics
projects.description: DEPI Mini Project 2. SQL Server, T-SQL, Python. 2026.
highlights: Built a retail data warehouse from a single flat file using Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and a star schema with three dimensions and one fact table.
Automated ETL with a Python Excel-to-CSV script, BULK INSERT, and truncate-and-reload stored procedures; added data quality checks per layer and a gold-layer data catalog.

Wrote SQL analysis scripts (change over time, cumulative, performance, part-to-whole) and customer and product KPI report views covering recency, average order value, segmentation, and customer lifespan.

projects.name: Superstore Retail Analytics
projects.description: DEPI Mini Project 1. Python, Pandas, SciPy. 2026.
highlights: Built an end-to-end Python pipeline on 9,994 retail orders ($2.29M sales, $284K profit, 12.4% margin) to identify profitability, shipping, and sales drivers.
Developed reusable object-oriented data cleaning and feature engineering classes with custom exception handling, IQR outlier detection, and fields such as Profit Margin and Discount Bucket.
Found a significant negative correlation between discount and profit (r = -0.22) and traced most losses to Tables, Bookcases, and Supplies, supporting a pricing recommendation.
Delivered 11 Matplotlib and Seaborn data visualizations, a dashboard, and an automated KPI report.
